sentences.en: Almost every night clouds develop over the ocean and move inland.
sentences.zh: 几乎每个夜晚，云都会在海洋上形成然后移动到内陆。

sentences.en: Chinese coastal cities are generally more developed than the inland ones.
sentences.zh: 中国的沿海城市通常比内地的城市发展得更好。

sentences.en: The inland taipan is the world's most venomous snake.
sentences.zh: 内陆尖吻蝮是世界上最毒的蛇。

senses.zh: 向内地；在内地；向内陆；在内陆
